consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1995-06-30 show at Three Rivers Stadium was a memorable experience, particularly due to the unique atmosphere created by the rain and the band's performance. The second set, featuring a series of rain-themed songs, is often highlighted as a standout moment, with many attendees recalling the magic of the moment when the rain began just as the band started playing 'Rain'.
